description: This file defines the 'Note' entity class for the backend, mapping to a database table 'notes' with fields for id, title, content, timestamps, and owner relationship. It includes JPA annotations for ORM mapping and lifecycle callbacks for timestamp management.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Entity class representing a note, with fields for id, title, content, timestamps, and owner user; includes lifecycle methods for timestamp management.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Lifecycle callback executed before persisting; sets createdAt and updatedAt to current timestamp.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback executed before updating; updates the updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: Note
methods.description: Default constructor for the Note entity.

methods.name: Note
methods.description: Constructor initializing title, content, and owner fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the note was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the note was last updated.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Returns the owner User object associated with the note.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner User object for the note.
